SASBDB entry SASDAN8  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDAN8/)

Publication: KSHV but not MHV-68 LANA induces a strong bend upon binding to terminal repeat viral DNA.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkv987

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDAN8/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
